json_ld.description:
Everything you need for safe, comfortable cat adventures. This complete walking kit includes our escape-resistant Cat Harness & Leash alongside a lightweight Breakaway Cat Collar for everyday wear. Designed specifically for cats, the harness features a comfort-first fit with adjustable straps and soft materials, while the breakaway collar includes a safety buckle designed to release under pressure. Finished with lightweight hardware and playful details, this all-in-one set makes it easy to gear up for both indoor and outdoor routines.
Important: The leash should only be attached to the harness — never to the breakaway collar.
json_ld.name: Cat Harness & Leash + Collar Kit
